prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1449; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the low-speed head-on collision described in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter, including requests for statements, recorded interviews, or settlement discussions, exclusively to this office and do not contact our client directly.

We ask that you provide the full policy limits for each policy that may apply to the at-fault driver, including any excess or umbrella coverage, along with a written confirmation of those limits within fourteen days of receipt of this letter.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes vehicle and telematics data, photographs, repair and salvage records, claim notes, adjuster reports, recorded statements, and any communications with the other driver or third parties. Please suspend any routine deletion or destruction of these materials until the claim is fully resolved.

Our client's injuries and treatment will be documented separately, and we will forward those records once they are available. Thank you for your prompt attention to these requests.
